Subject: Pricing cadence & Order Form redlines — Orchard Health

Hi Paul —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a draft Order Form that aligns to the term sheet we agreed on. High-level items I want to flag so legal/finance know what to expect:

- Pricing schedule: 12-month term with a three-step ramp (25% first 90 days, 50% next 3 months, 100% final 6 months). Unit price and token bands are in the attachment.
- Minimum commit: $225k annual commitment, invoiced in three tranches (Q1/Q2/Q3) per the ramp above.
- Net terms: Orchard asked for Net45 rather than our standard Net30 — noted as a request; need internal approval.
- Taxes & invoicing: Orchard prefers invoices to go to a central Finance entity (finance@orchard.health); they may withhold VAT/withholding taxes depending on country. We should include evidence required for tax residency.
- Legal redlines: small MSA pointers (billing address, invoice remit entity, and an invoice-attachment clause so they can attach PO).

Can you confirm: 1) PO number and remittance entity (if different from finance@orchard.health), and 2) whether the procurement team needs invoices split by entity or consolidated? If you can send the PO we can circulate the redline to Legal and Finance and aim for a DocuSign-ready Order Form by EOD Friday.

Attaching: Orchard_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx (tracked changes)

Thanks —

Thanks for the context and the redline. Legal is comfortable with Net45 for this customer under two conditions:

1) We add an explicit early-payment incentive and a clause that preserves our right to suspend service for late payment after a short cure period (30 days past due) — this balances their request with our exposure.
2) We require the PO (ORCH-2028-211) to be attached to the Order Form at signing and a billing contact email on the first page (we can use finance@orchard.health).

Other clarifications:
- Minimum commit remains $225k annually as stated; if invoices are consolidated, Finance should map collections to the appropriate contracts for revenue recognition.
- Taxes: we will include a tax-evidence attachment checklist in the Order Form and request their tax residency certificate prior to first invoice.

I’ve added tracked comments to Orchard_OrderForm_Redline_v1.docx and prepared a short DocuSign wrapper (link below) that reflects Net45 + early-pay discount (1.5% if paid within 10 days). If Finance approves the payment schedule and receivable mapping, Legal can sign off and we can send the DocuSign envelope.
